##### Project general facts

Introducing Nasim Lofts at Bay Residence, the project by RAK Properties situated on the prestigious Hayat Island in Mina Al Arab. This exquisite development brings together the splendor of natural beauty and the epitome of luxury living. Nasim Lofts offers a limited collection of two and three-bedroom residences, carefully designed to provide an unparalleled living experience. With direct beach access, residents can indulge in the soothing embrace of the Arabian Gulf and revel in the beauty of pristine sandy shores just steps away from their homes.

At Bay Residence, residents will have access to the best-in-class amenities that the region has to offer. Whether it's taking a dip in the shimmering swimming pools, staying active in the state-of-the-art fitness facilities, or strolling through beautifully landscaped gardens, there is something to cater to every lifestyle need.

Step into these thoughtfully crafted lofts and be greeted by a sense of grandeur with double-height ceilings that create a spacious and airy atmosphere. The architectural design not only maximizes natural light but also provides residents with stunning views of the surrounding beachscape. Each bedroom within Nasim Lofts is en-suite, ensuring privacy and convenience for residents. Impeccably designed, the interiors boast luxurious finishes and meticulous attention to detail, exemplifying the highest standards of craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Mina Al Arab is a waterfront development located in Ras Al Khaimah, one of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates (UAE). It is a luxurious residential and tourism project situated along the coast of the Arabian Gulf, offering stunning views and a resort-like ambiance.

Developed by RAK Properties, Mina Al Arab spans over an area of approximately 2.7 million square meters. The development was meticulously designed to create a harmonious blend of natural beauty and modern living. It incorporates lush landscapes, pristine beaches, and a range of world-class amenities.

The community of Mina Al Arab also offers a range of facilities and amenities to cater to the needs of its residents. These include swimming pools, gyms, parks, children's play areas, retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants. The development aims to provide a holistic lifestyle experience, where residents can relax, socialize, and engage in various recreational activities.

Furthermore, Mina Al Arab features a promenade that stretches along the waterfront, offering a vibrant atmosphere for residents and visitors. The promenade is lined with shops, eateries, and entertainment venues, creating a lively and engaging environment.

The development's location in Ras Al Khaimah provides easy access to other parts of the emirate, as well as neighboring emirates such as Dubai and Sharjah. This allows residents to enjoy a tranquil coastal lifestyle while still being in proximity to urban centers and major amenities.
